name: Kalach
text: Kalach (Russian: Кала́ч) is a town and the administrative center of Kalacheyevsky District in Voronezh Oblast, Russia, located at the confluence of the Tolucheyevka and Podgornaya Rivers, 294 kilometers (183 mi) from Voronezh, the administrative center of the oblast. Population:  20,046 (2010 census); 20,950 (2002 census); 23,183 (1989 Soviet census).

depictions.text: cod2 Kalach is a multiplayer map featured in Call of Duty 2. It was released as part of the Skirmish Map Pack.
